idle.notes: Idle, weight shifting and breathing (Universal Animation Library, retargeted)

patrol_look.notes: Patrol idle: scans left and right. Loop.

aim.notes: Shouldered aim idle (weight on back foot). Loop.

shoot.notes: One blaster bolt: trigger squeeze, kick, settle. Muzzle bone = bolt spawn. Loop for sustained fire.

reload.notes: Power-cell swap: tilt, pull cell, stow on belt, seat new cell, back to aim.

die.notes: Blaster bolt: hit, slow sag to the knees, sway, topple forward; physics ragdoll from the topple (muscle tone fades), flat and limp on the ground.

die_headshot.notes: Headshot: goes limp while standing and falls forward nearly straight, flat on the ground (physics ragdoll).

die_headshot_back.notes: Headshot: goes limp while standing and falls backward nearly straight, flat on the ground (physics ragdoll).

hit_foot.notes: Shot in the right foot: the foot jerks up, he hops and staggers.

die_back.notes: Blown backward: violent jolt, two stumbling steps back, lands on his back, legs bounce. Blaster flung away.

die_run.notes: Shot while running: momentum throws him forward into a sliding faceplant (travels ~1.3 m). Blaster flies ahead.

jump.notes: Jump: take-off, airborne, landing (Universal Animation Library, retargeted).

walk_limp.notes: Injured (shot in the right foot): limping walk, weight kept off the right leg. 0.9 m/s.

aim_walk_fwd.notes: Tactical walk forward while aiming (soft knees, stable rifle). 1.3 m/s.

tiptoe_walk.notes: Sneaking on tiptoe: weight on the balls of the feet, heels never touch, soft knees. 0.7 m/s.

melee.notes: Rifle-butt melee strike with a step.

signal_moveup.notes: Patrol hand signal: move up (forward point).

look_left.notes: Head/neck look offset pose (additive: neck and head turn, upper chest follows a little).

look_right.notes: Head/neck look offset pose (additive: neck and head turn, upper chest follows a little).

look_up.notes: Head/neck look offset pose (additive: neck and head turn, upper chest follows a little).

look_down.notes: Head/neck look offset pose (additive: neck and head turn, upper chest follows a little).

look_tilt_l.notes: Head/neck look offset pose (additive: neck and head turn, upper chest follows a little).

look_tilt_r.notes: Head/neck look offset pose (additive: neck and head turn, upper chest follows a little).

look_around.notes: Looks left, up, right and down; the neck leads, the head follows, the chest turns a little. Loop.

neck_roll.notes: Neck roll: chin down, ear to the right shoulder, head back, ear to the left, back to centre.

count_five.notes: Counts to five on the left hand, palm out: index, middle, ring, pinky, then the thumb, one finger at a time.

beckon.notes: Come here: left hand out palm up, the index finger straightens and curls back four times; other fingers folded.

tiptoe_peek.notes: Rises onto the balls of the feet to look over a wall, scans, settles back on the heels.

roll_to_kneel.notes: Combat roll: dives forward, rolls over the shoulder, comes up on one knee aiming down the sights and fires three bolts. Root motion ~2.3 m.

kneel_aim.notes: Kneeling aim down the sights (one knee down). Loop.

kneel_shoot.notes: Kneeling bolt with recoil. Loop for sustained fire.

climb_ladder.notes: Ladder climb, hand-over-hand with opposite feet, blaster slung on the back. In place loop at 0.5 m/s (move the character up).

mantle.notes: Mantle up a 1.1 m ledge: left hand plants, right knee drives up, stands on top. Blaster stays in the right hand. Root motion (0.82 m forward, 1.1 m up).

saber_hit_1.notes: First lightsaber contact: burned across the chest, twists away and steps back, recovers.

saber_hit_2.notes: Second lightsaber contact: doubles over, left hand clutches the burn, staggers, recovers.

saber_death_arm.notes: Lightsaber third hit: right arm severed. Clutches the stump, staggers back, drops to his knees, falls forward.

saber_death_leg.notes: Lightsaber third hit: left leg severed at the thigh. Topples sideways, lands on his side, rolls onto his back.

saber_death_head.notes: Lightsaber third hit: beheaded. The body stands a moment, arms drop, knees buckle straight down, falls forward.

saber_death_half.notes: Lightsaber third hit: cut in half at the waist. The legs stand a beat then topple; the upper body slides back off and falls.

saber_death_diagonal.notes: Lightsaber third hit: cut diagonally shoulder to hip. The upper piece slides down the cut and falls; the hips and legs crumple.

death_explosion.notes: Explosion in front: completely limp, blown backward through the air, flips, lands on his back.

death_explosion_arm.notes: Explosion from his left: thrown sideways with a spin, left arm blown off, lands on his front.

death_explosion_leg.notes: Explosion beneath him: launched high, somersaults forward, right leg blown off, lands face down.

death_explosion_armleg.notes: Explosion behind him: cartwheels forward, right arm and left leg blown off, lands on his side.

wounded_down.notes: Wounded on his back: presses the wound, writhes, blaster held across the chest. Loop.

wounded_crawl.notes: Wounded: pushes himself backward along the ground with his legs, 0.3 m/s. Loop.

drag_rescuer.notes: Rescuer drags a wounded trooper to safety: walks backward bent over, left hand on the collar, blaster up one-handed. 0.9 m/s. Pair with drag_wounded.

drag_wounded.notes: Wounded trooper being dragged by the collar: torso lifted, heels sliding, arms trailing. Pair with drag_rescuer (offset in drag_pair.json).

stack_up.notes: Stacked on a door: crouched, rifle low, left hand on the shoulder of the trooper in front. Loop.

breach_clear.notes: Breach and clear: steps through the doorway rifle up, sweeping the room left to right. Root motion 1.6 m.

stairs_up_aim.notes: Climbing stairs while aiming: 2 steps per loop, 18 cm rise, 28 cm run (0.56 m forward, 0.36 m up per loop).

carry_crate.notes: Logistics: carries a supply crate in both hands, blaster slung. 1.0 m/s. Crate on the prop bone.

crate_pickup.notes: Logistics: squats, grips a crate on the ground, lifts it to the chest (ends in carry_crate hold).

crate_putdown.notes: Logistics: squats and sets the crate down, stands up.

radio_call.notes: Radio operator: hand to the helmet comlink, talking, scanning. Loop.

mortar_load.notes: Artillery crew: kneeling at the mortar, drops a round down the tube, ducks and covers his helmet, back up. Round on the prop bone.

grenade_throw.notes: Throws a thermal detonator with the left hand (released at 0.72 s), back on the blaster. Detonator on the prop bone.

suppress.notes: Suppressing fire: sustained bolts every 0.12 s with recoil. Loop.

checkpoint_halt.notes: Roadblock: left palm raised, halting the vehicle or person, blaster low ready. Loop.

check_credentials.notes: Roadblock: takes the travel papers / datapad, reads and checks them, hands them back. Datapad on the prop bone.

inspect_freight.notes: Roadblock: bends over a cargo crate, lifts the lid, searches inside for weapons, closes it. Blaster slung.

attention.notes: At attention, blaster at port arms, heels together: standing for an officer. Loop.

command_point.notes: Officer / sergeant: points the squad to a position.

command_advance.notes: Officer / sergeant: arm up, then chops forward: "advance".

getup_back.notes: Get up from lying on his back (after being patched up): sits up, rolls onto a knee, pushes up, ready.

getup_front.notes: Get up from face down or prone: pushes up, knees under, one knee, stands at the ready. Also prone-to-stand.

medic_treat.notes: Medic kneeling over a wounded trooper, working on his chest (blaster slung). Loop.

cover_low_idle.notes: Behind low cover (about 1 m): crouched, blaster up at the chest, head down, glancing. Loop.

cover_low_fire.notes: Low cover: pops up over the wall, fires 3 bolts (0.5, 0.75, 1.0 s), drops back down.

cover_high_idle.notes: Behind tall cover, wall edge on his right: standing close, blaster at port, watching the edge. Loop.

cover_lean_fire_r.notes: Tall cover: steps and leans out to the right, fires 3 bolts, back behind the wall.

cover_lean_fire_l.notes: Tall cover: steps and leans out to the left, fires 3 bolts, back behind the wall.

go_prone.notes: Drops from standing to prone: kneels, falls forward onto the elbows, rifle aimed.

prone_aim.notes: Prone, up on the elbows, aiming. Loop.

prone_shoot.notes: Prone bolt with recoil. Loop for sustained fire.

prone_crawl.notes: Prone crawl on elbows and knees, rifle cradled forward. 0.4 m/s. Loop.

turn_l90.notes: Turn on the spot (+132 deg; heading on the root bone), from mixamo/Turns_mixamo.fbx

turn_r90.notes: Turn on the spot (-6 deg; heading on the root bone), from mixamo/Turns_mixamo.fbx

run_stop.notes: Stops from a run: leans back, two braking steps, settles at the ready (root motion ~1.2 m).

dive_left.notes: Dives to the left away from a grenade or fire, lands on his side with the rifle up (root motion ~2.5 m).

dive_right.notes: Dives to the right away from a grenade or fire, lands on his side with the rifle up (root motion ~2.5 m).

vault.notes: Vaults a 1 m wall: left hand on top, legs swing over, lands and moves on. Blaster kept in the right hand (root motion 1.6 m).

hit_left.notes: Blaster hit from the left: twists away and side-steps, recovers.

hit_right.notes: Blaster hit from the right: twists away and side-steps, recovers.

flinch_duck.notes: Explosion nearby: ducks low, left arm over the helmet, back up.

walk_formal.notes: Formal walk (officers on inspection) (Universal Animation Library, retargeted)

hit_chest.notes: Hit in the chest (Universal Animation Library, retargeted)

hit_head.notes: Hit in the head (Universal Animation Library, retargeted)

die_fall.notes: Death fall (alternative to the ragdoll deaths) (Universal Animation Library, retargeted)

idle_talking.notes: Talking while standing (Universal Animation Library, retargeted)

interact.notes: Reach out and use a panel or object (Universal Animation Library, retargeted)

pickup_table.notes: Pick something up from a table (Universal Animation Library, retargeted)

push.notes: Pushing a heavy object (Universal Animation Library, retargeted)

repair_kneeling.notes: Kneeling repair work (mechanics, logistics) (Universal Animation Library, retargeted)

sit_talking.notes: Sitting and talking (Universal Animation Library, retargeted)

sit_up.notes: Get up from sitting (Universal Animation Library, retargeted)

drive.notes: Driving / piloting seat pose (Universal Animation Library, retargeted)

turn_l180.notes: Turn on the spot (+178 deg; heading on the root bone), from mixamo/Turns_mixamo.fbx

turn_l180_04.notes: Turn on the spot (+177 deg; heading on the root bone), from mixamo/Turns_mixamo.fbx

turn_r180.notes: Turn on the spot (-138 deg; heading on the root bone), from mixamo/Turns_mixamo.fbx

fall_bounce.notes: Falling and bouncing off a ledge (from humanik/Falling_BouncingoffCouch_HUMANIK_TF1.fbx, frames 71-2376)
